title: Let Grafana Assistant build your first dashboard
body: Click the [Assistant](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/machine-learning/grafana-assistant/) icon (top-right) and describe what you want in plain English. It writes the [PromQL](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/datasources/prometheus/query-editor/) or [LogQL](https://grafana.com/docs/loki/latest/query/) and lays out panels for you.

title: Drilldowns beat raw queries when you're exploring
body: Try [Metrics Drilldown](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/visualizations/simplified-exploration/metrics/) under **Explore > Metrics** to point-and-click filter labels and break down by dimension. Same for [Logs](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/visualizations/simplified-exploration/logs/), [Traces](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/visualizations/simplified-exploration/traces/), and [Profiles](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/visualizations/simplified-exploration/profiles/).

title: Logs Drilldown reads logs without LogQL
body: Auto-extracts fields and surfaces [volume, patterns, and errors](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/visualizations/simplified-exploration/logs/investigate-logs/) visually. No [LogQL](https://grafana.com/docs/loki/latest/query/) required.

title: Use $__rate_interval for rate() queries
body: Hardcoding `rate(metric[5m])` breaks at long ranges. [`rate(metric[$__rate_interval])`](https://grafana.com/blog/2020/09/28/new-in-grafana-7.2-__rate_interval-for-prometheus-rate-queries-that-just-work/) auto-picks a window matching your [scrape interval](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/datasources/prometheus/template-variables/).

title: Integrations beat hand-rolled Alloy configs
body: [Connections > Add new connection](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/connect-externally-hosted/) has [prebuilt integrations](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/monitor-infrastructure/integrations/) for hundreds of systems with dashboards and alerts included. Try one before writing [Alloy](https://grafana.com/docs/alloy/latest/) config by hand.

title: Adaptive Metrics cuts your bill without losing signal
body: [Adaptive Metrics](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/cost-management-and-billing/reduce-costs/metrics-costs/control-metrics-usage-via-adaptive-metrics/) aggregates high-cardinality series you aren't querying. 20-50% cost reduction with zero dashboard changes. Find it under [Cost Management](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/cost-management-and-billing/).

title: Annotate deploys to correlate spikes with releases
body: Add an [annotation query](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/dashboards/build-dashboards/annotate-visualizations/) for your CI deploy events. Vertical lines appear on every panel showing exactly when something shipped.

title: Service accounts, not API keys
body: [API keys](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/administration/api-keys/) are legacy. Use [service accounts](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/administration/service-accounts/) (**Administration > Service accounts**) with scoped permissions and rotatable [tokens](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/administration/service-accounts/#add-a-token-to-a-service-account-in-grafana). Required for new Cloud features.

title: Variables make one dashboard work for every environment
body: Add a [`$env` variable](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/dashboards/variables/) (**Settings > Variables**) and query like `up{env="$env"}`. Combine with [multi-value and 'All'](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/dashboards/variables/variable-selection-options/) for the full effect.

title: Alerting: contact points are reusable, notification policies route
body: Define a [contact point](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/alerting/configure-notifications/manage-contact-points/) (Slack, PagerDuty, email) once. Then build [notification policies](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/alerting/configure-notifications/create-notification-policy/) that match labels and route alerts to the right team.
